# polaris_catalog_role (Resource)

Manages an Apache Polaris catalog role scoped to a catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_catalog_role" "catalog_admin" {
  catalog_name = polaris_catalog.analytics.name
  name         = "catalog_admin"

  properties = {
    description = "Full administrator for analytics catalog"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) The catalog in which the role is created.
- `name` (String) The name of the catalog role.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this catalog role.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter for optimistic concurrency.
- `id` (String) The composite identifier of the catalog role in format `catalog_name/role_name`.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
